name: Turso
description: Turso is a cutting-edge platform designed to revolutionize the way developers interact with databases. It offers a seamless and efficient experience for managing, querying, and scaling databases, making it an essential tool for modern software development. With Turso, developers can focus on building applications without worrying about the complexities of database management.
